cards.ex: Since I missed the last bus, I had to hitch a ride with a trucker to get home.
cards.exUz: Oxirgi avtobusdan qolib ketganimdan keyin, uyga yetib olish uchun yuk mashinasidan tekin minishga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Avtomobilda bepul sayohat qilish, ko'pincha begonalardan yordam so'rash orqali.

cards.ex: We prefer traveling in the shoulder season to avoid the crowds and high prices.
cards.exUz: Olomon va yuqori narxlardan qochish uchun o'tish davrida sayohat qilishni afzal ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori va past turizm mavsumlari orasidagi vaqt.

cards.ex: After losing his passport, he had to sleep rough for a few nights until he could get help.
cards.exUz: Passportini yo'qotgandan so'ng, yordam olguncha bir necha kecha ko'chada tunashga majbur bo'ldi.

cards.ex: She quit her job to see the world and experience new cultures.
cards.exUz: U yangi madaniyatlarni ko'rish va dunyo ko'rish uchun ishdan bo'shadi.
cards.uzDef: Turli mamlakatlarni va joylarni sayohat qilish orqali o'rganish.

cards.ex: They decided to go off the grid for a week and stay in a remote cabin in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Ular bir hafta aloqasiz qolishga va tog'lardagi uzoq kulbada qolishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Zamonaviy texnologiyalardan va kommunikatsiyalardan uzoqda bo'lish.

cards.ex: This little guesthouse is a real home from home; I feel so comfortable here.
cards.exUz: Bu kichik mehmonxona haqiqiy o'z uyim kabi; o'zimni juda qulay his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: O'z uyingizdagidek qulay va yoqimli joy.

cards.ex: We took a hop-on hop-off bus tour to see all the main attractions in the city.
cards.exUz: Biz shahardagi barcha asosiy diqqatga sazovor joylarni ko'rish uchun chiqib-tushish avtobus ekskursiyasiga bordik.
cards.uzDef: Bitta chipta bilan avtobusdan tushib, yana chiqish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: They always travel in style, staying in the best hotels and flying first class.
cards.exUz: Ular har doim eng yaxshi mehmonxonalarda qolish va birinchi sinfda uchish orqali hashamatli sayohat qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Qulay va dabdabali tarzda sayohat qilish.

cards.ex: We wanted to get off the beaten track and explore some of the smaller villages.
cards.exUz: Biz mashhur bo'lmagan joylarga borishni va kichikroq qishloqlarni o'rganishni xohladik.

cards.ex: I can only make a flying visit this weekend, as I have a lot of work to do.
cards.exUz: Menda ko'p ish borligi sababli, bu dam olish kunlari faqat qisqa tashrif buyurishim mumkin.

cards.ex: We booked a sightseeing tour to see all the historical landmarks in Rome.
cards.exUz: Biz Rimdagi barcha tarixiy joylarni ko'rish uchun ekskursiyaga buyurtma berdik.

cards.ex: We didn't book any tours; we're just going to wing it and see what happens.
cards.exUz: Biz hech qanday ekskursiyaga buyurtma bermadik; shunchaki tayyorgarliksiz boramiz va nima bo'lishini ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirmasdan, vaziyatga qarab ish tutish.

cards.ex: They decided to go backpacking through Southeast Asia for a few months.
cards.exUz: Ular bir necha oy davomida Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyo bo'ylab ryukzak bilan sayohat qilishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ryukzak bilan, arzon usulda sayohat qilish.

cards.ex: To get the most out of your trip, plan your itinerary carefully.
cards.exUz: Sayohatdan eng ko'p foyda olish uchun marshrutingizni diqqat bilan rejalashtiring.

cards.ex: We're planning a short break to the coast next month.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi oy qirg'oqqa qisqa dam olishni rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq bo'lmagan, qisqa muddatli dam olish.

cards.ex: We're setting off early tomorrow morning to avoid the traffic.
cards.exUz: Ertaga ertalab tirbandlikdan qochish uchun yo'lga chiqamiz.

cards.ex: We're planning a road trip across the country this summer.
cards.exUz: Biz bu yoz mamlakat bo'ylab avtosayohatni rejalashtiryapmiz.

cards.ex: A weekend in the countryside is a nice change of pace from city life.
cards.exUz: Dam olish kunlarini qishloqda o'tkazish shahar hayotidan yaxshi hayot tarzini o'zgartirishdir.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagi hayotdan farqli tarzda dam olish.

cards.ex: The hotel staff really went the extra mile to make our stay enjoyable.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona xodimlari bizning qolishimizni yoqimli qilish uchun haqiqatan ham qo'shimcha harakat qilishdi.

cards.ex: Let's make the most of this beautiful weather and go for a walk.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu ajoyib ob-havodan foydalanib qolaylik va sayrga chiqaylik.

cards.ex: I always get the holiday blues when I have to go back to work.
cards.exUz: Men har doim ishga qaytishim kerak bo'lganda ta'til xafaligini his qilaman.

cards.ex: I never got around to visiting the museum when I was in Paris.
cards.exUz: Parijda bo'lganimda muzeyga tashrif buyurishga hech vaqt topa olmadim.

cards.ex: The beach is just a stone's throw from our hotel.
cards.exUz: Plyaj bizning mehmonxonamizdan juda yaqin masofada joylashgan.

cards.ex: They say travel broadens the mind, and I definitely feel more open-minded after my trip.
cards.exUz: Ular sayohat fikrni kengaytiradi deyishadi va men sayohatimdan keyin o'zimni ancha ochiq fikrli his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat yangi narsalarni o'rganishga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: I went for a hike to blow off some steam after a stressful week at work.
cards.exUz: Ishdagi stressli haftadan keyin biroz stressdan xalos bo'lish uchun sayrga bordim.

cards.ex: We're leaving tomorrow, so I need to pack my bags tonight.
cards.exUz: Ertaga ketyapmiz, shuning uchun bugun kechqurun yukimni yig'ishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun narsalarni sumkaga solmoq.

cards.ex: After living there for a year, she started to go native and learn the local customs.
cards.exUz: U yerda bir yil yashagandan so'ng, u mahalliy bo'lib qola boshladi va mahalliy urf-odatlarni o'rgandi.

cards.ex: The chef spent his holiday visiting other restaurants; it was a busman's holiday.
cards.exUz: Oshpaz ta'tilini boshqa restoranlarga tashrif buyurish bilan o'tkazdi; bu ishlaydigan ta'til edi.

cards.ex: After the holiday, I need to hit the ground running at work.
cards.exUz: Ta'tildan so'ng, ishda tez va samarali tarzda boshlashim kerak.

cards.ex: Traveling in the off-season means fewer crowds and lower prices.
cards.exUz: Mavsumdan tashqari sayohat qilish olomon kamroq va narxlar arzonroq deganidir.
